main_text.p: Cap.8. Seruatorem, ad quem omnes confugere oporteat,qui voluut feruari,Actor.4 Ioh. 4.Errant, qui vnum quenque in fua reli‐gione putant feruari. Officium item erga proximum, ne aliquem faltidiamus propter gentem, &c.
main_text.head: II. Conditio. Eunuchus. Sic olim dſti
main_text.p: Conditio Eunuchus & princeps. Satrapæ,regibus & reginis familiariores. Neue vulgaris putetur,additur† Item præfectus toti gazæ. Potentiæ Christi argumentum, qui potentissimos quoque poteft ad se pertrahere,licet multa remorentur. Opes. Matt 19. Honores, Ioh.5 12. Pericula. Si velit omnia obstacula ille tollit, Psal.2 72.Ita Magos adduxit, Matt.2. Hodie idem experimur.

Nota Magistratus non excludi a Christo & salute. Magistratus enim institutus a Deo, Rom.13. At is nihil instituit, quod salutem impediat,1.Timoth.2. Ana‐baptistæ obijciunt exemplum Christi,Iohan.6 Luc.12. Idem quod dixit,Luc.22. At Christus non venerat regni caufa, Iohan. 18. Sed vt regnu Dei instauraret, quod omnis loci homines recipit, Galat.3. Colos. 2. Vt igitur olim fuerunt sancti principes. Ita tales erunt in Nouo Testamento, Isa: 49. Tales fuerunt Iosephus Arimathæus, Lucæ 23. Matthæi27. Centuriones Matthæi.

page.notes: Printed page is a heavily faded early modern page; marginal labels at left are partly illegible. Transcription of Greek word in Eunuchus line (eunuchus, "ἀνήρ"-type word after "additur") and Hebrew-free; the Greek term after "additur" is rendered approximately and should be checked. Several words in the text are doubtful due to fading, e.g. "Vt igitur" and "Ita tales erunt" lines.
